about_the_game:
"The world doesn't need saving, so go ahead and have fun." - Morgan

Demo Contents:
~10 days to spend on jobs or classes
The first story mission 'Black Forest Orcs'
A special start with increased stats to jump right into the story mission
Note that the ability to save or advance time past the 1st of Autumn is disabled in this demo

Raising simulation meets cute and cozy heroic fantasy. You are Niziiro Mao, a happy-go-lucky Ink Mage who just finished your spring semester classes. Acknowledging your efforts, her majesty decided you're ready to take missions from her.

Your first mission? A little field trip to the Black Forest to meet the orcs living there.

If you don't feel prepared enough, you can squeeze in a few more classes to learn new skills. Train hard to make sure ready to face everything the mission might throw at you. Walk around, have adventures, meet new people, and maybe even drop meteors on the ones you don't like in turn based JRPG combat.

If things get too stressful, take a walk outside the city, eat something delicious, or have a nice nap to keep yourself rested.

Her majesty has a considerably laissez-faire approach to education, so you are free to make your own schedule. However, although her backing means you can try any job or class you'd like, you still need to work hard yourself.

A slight painting accident. Sadly, you don't get paid for unsuccessful work.

Asking her majesty for pocket money. (You can usually find her in the Reception Hall. Walk around the Palace if you don't know where it is.)

Should they really be teaching Fireball in school?

Then again, they already taught you Meteor.

Featuring:

Trash talk after dropping a giant flaming rock on an adventuring party.

Hat based political hierarchy.

A slightly depressed goblin, Oliver.

A mission to conquer the world? (And quite possibly the least secret agent who ever lived.)

Niziiro Mao, fighter of slimes and paper dolls. The super fighting expert who conveniently forgot to mention that she lost some of those matches.

"My greatest wish? I suppose it would be my entry in the history books. I would like to have a little footnote with the date of my coronation, the date of the end of my reign, and a statement saying 'nothing of note happened under her reign.' It's a little amusing. Things like bountiful harvests, children's smiles, and peaceful, ordinary days never make it into the books. And let's keep it that way, shall we? Even if the sky falls, I'll be here to hold it up." - Morgan

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Graphics: Support for Vulkan 1.2
